summary_en: 613,193 treasury shares to be cancelled on 2026-08-01, immediately prior to Hikari Tsushin's acquisition of 100% of FTGroup under stock-exchange agreement effective 2026-08-01. Cancellation required by stock-exchange contract terms.
title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: FTGroup's board resolved on 2026-06-23 to cancel all treasury shares held at the reference time (直前時), defined as the moment immediately before Hikari Tsushin acquires 100% of FTGroup's issued shares under a stock-exchange agreement executed on 2026-03-31. The cancellation is mandatory under the terms of that stock-exchange contract and will take effect on 2026-08-01, coinciding with the completion of the acquisition. As of 2026-03-31, FTGroup held 613,193 treasury shares against 30,342,268 shares issued and outstanding (ex-treasury), representing 2.0% of the ex-treasury base. The cancellation will eliminate these shares before the company becomes a wholly owned subsidiary.
